cond.zh: Σ输出 ≤ Σ输入 时 sudt 直接通过；若交易消费元数据 cell，减少量由 sudt-meta 记为协议销毁，否则为用户销毁（不减 supply）
cond.en: Σout ≤ Σin passes in sudt; if the tx spends the metadata cell, sudt-meta accounts the decrease as a protocol burn, else it is user destruction (supply unchanged)

label.en: metadata cell (must be an input when tracked)

extras.zh: cell_deps：untracked 时元数据 cell 可在 cell_deps
extras.en: cell_deps: when untracked the metadata cell may be a cell_dep

role.zh: 元数据 cell 的 type hash（type id 脚本的 hash）
role.en: type hash of the metadata cell

role.zh: 数量；之后的字节被忽略

note.zh: sudt-meta 只统计 hash_type = data2、code_hash = SUDT_CODE_HASH、args = 元数据 type hash 的 cell
note.en: sudt-meta only counts cells with hash_type = data2, code_hash = SUDT_CODE_HASH, args = metadata type hash

cond.zh: 先 cell_deps、再输入，type hash = args；同一来源多于一个 → 42；解析失败 → 40
cond.en: cell_deps first, then inputs, type hash = args; more than one in a source → 42; parse failure → 40

cond.zh: cell_deps / 输入都没有时，输出中必须有元数据 cell（由 sudt-meta 校验创建）
cond.en: if neither has it, the outputs must contain the metadata cell (creation checked by sudt-meta)

cond.zh: 元数据必须来自输入（来自 cell_dep → 43）；supply 由 sudt-meta 记账
cond.en: metadata must come from an input (cell_dep → 43); supply is accounted by sudt-meta

notes.zh: 错误码（contracts/sudt/src/error.rs）：1–9 SysError、10 SyscallUnknown、20 InvalidArgs、30 AmountEncoding、31 AmountOverflow、32 SupplyOverflow、33 SupplyUnderflow、40 InvalidMetaData、41 MetaMissing、42 MetaNotUnique、43 MetaInputMissing、44 MetaOutputMissing、45 MetaStateMismatch、50 AuthorityMissing、51 AuthorityFailed、52 UnsupportedAuthorityLocation。32、33、44 在 sudt 中未使用。
notes.en: Error codes (contracts/sudt/src/error.rs): 1–9 SysError, 10 SyscallUnknown, 20 InvalidArgs, 30 AmountEncoding, 31 AmountOverflow, 32 SupplyOverflow, 33 SupplyUnderflow, 40 InvalidMetaData, 41 MetaMissing, 42 MetaNotUnique, 43 MetaInputMissing, 44 MetaOutputMissing, 45 MetaStateMismatch, 50 AuthorityMissing, 51 AuthorityFailed, 52 UnsupportedAuthorityLocation. 32, 33 and 44 are unused in sudt.

notes.zh: README 说 sudt 校验“协议销毁分类与用户销毁”，但 entry.rs 只在 Σ输出 > Σ输入 时调用 validate_mint；减少量完全由 sudt-meta（当元数据 cell 被消费时）记账。
notes.en: The README says sudt validates “protocol-burn classification and user destruction”, but entry.rs only calls validate_mint when Σout > Σin; decreases are accounted solely by sudt-meta (when the metadata cell is spent).

notes.zh: sudt 不检查自身 hash_type，而 sudt-meta 只统计 data2 绑定的 cell：用其他 hash_type 引用同一二进制的 sUDT 不会计入 tracked supply。untracked 首次铸造（元数据在输出中）不检查 authority。
notes.en: sudt does not check its own hash_type, while sudt-meta only counts data2-bound cells: an sUDT referencing the same binary with another hash_type is not counted in tracked supply. An untracked initial mint (metadata in outputs) checks no authority.

notes.zh: 授权方式：InputLock / InputType = 输入中有该 lock / type hash；OutputType = 输出中有该 type hash；DynamicLinking 调用 udt_authorize；Spawn 退出码 0
notes.en: Authority: InputLock / InputType = an input has that lock / type hash; OutputType = an output has that type hash; DynamicLinking calls udt_authorize; Spawn must exit 0
